From Wiktionary, the free dictionary
See also: comic, cómic, còmic, and çomıç

German

[edit]
German Wikipedia has an article on:
Comic
Wikipedia de

Etymology

[edit]

Borrowed from English comic.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • Audio (Germany (Berlin)):(file)

Noun

[edit]

Comic m or n (strong, genitive Comic or Comics, plural Comics)

  1. comic, comic strip or comic book

Declension

[edit]
Declension of Comic [masculine // neuter, strong]
singular plural
indef. def. noun def. noun
nominative ein der, das Comic die Comics
genitive eines des Comic, Comics der Comics
dative einem dem Comic den Comics
accusative einen, ein den, das Comic die Comics

Synonyms

[edit]
  • (strip): Comicstrip/Comic-Strip
  • (book): Comicbuch, Comicheft, Comiczeitschrift

Hypernyms

[edit]
  • (strip): Bildgeschichte, Bildergeschichte

Related terms

[edit]
  • Comicautor, Comicbuchladen, Comicfigur, Comicgeschichte, Comicheld, Comicleser, Comicliebhaber, Comic-Klassiker, Comic-Künstler, Comicliteratur, Comicmarkt, Comicreihe, Comicserie, Comicszene, Comicverfilmung, Comicverlag, Comiczeichner, Comiczeitschrift
  • Abenteuercomic, Actioncomic, Bildungscomic, Fancomic, Geschichtscomic, Politcomic, Propaganda-Comic, Wissenschaftscomic, Zeitungscomic
